node.statement: For every class C in the finite class family, apply lem-maincb-one-class-extension to this same explicit MAIN partition state and the original w. Its hypotheses are exactly the extended W.c0_cb*epsilon-inclusion and near-unit bound on w, 0<=epsilon<=W.epsilon_MAIN, the one-dimensional atomic images, and that C is one equivalence class. It yields a current reset isomorphism v_C:M_{|C|}->A_C with A_C extended epsilon_C-C*, epsilon_C<=W.L*epsilon<=W.K_call*epsilon, d_C<=W.c0_cb*epsilon_C, and ||v_C(I)-u_{A_C}||<=W.c0_cb*epsilon_C.
